item.title: Causal graphs, long-context guardrails and agent conflicts
item.description: Causal Evidentiary Governance, where lenders commit to a causal graph and ship signed evidence per decision; LongGuard, finding safety guardrails lose half their unsafe recall on long inputs; and KC-Bench, showing agents accepting false premises and mismatched identities. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.
